These types ship in the `Microsoft.UI.Reactor.Advanced` package. The `DockManager` element and its modifiers are in the elements and modifiers categories.

**Learn more:** [Docking Windows](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/guides/docking)

## Types [#types]

| Type | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Dock events](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/events) | Event arguments the dock manager raises. |
| [Docking diagnostics](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/diagnostics) | A log of the operations the dock manager performed. |
| [Docking strings](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/strings) | Resource keys and default strings for the docking UI. |
| [Layout model](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/layout-model) | The nodes, panes and targets that make up a dock layout. |
| [Layout persistence](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/persistence) | Save, load and migrate dock layouts. |
| [Native window interop](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/native) | Floating windows, display bounds and the layout snapshots exchanged with native code. |
| [`DockContexts`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/DockContexts) | Context slots used to surface docking state to function components via the `DockHooks` hooks. |
| [`DockHostModel`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/DockHostModel) | Internal source-of-truth for a `DockManager` host's runtime layout state. |
| [`DockLayoutOps`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/DockLayoutOps) | Spec 046 §6.4 — public façade over the layout-tree operations apps need to build, mutate, and inspect a `DockNode` tree programmatically (e.g. an "Open new document" button that should route through role-aware `DockTarget.Center` insert, or a "Close pane" handler that needs the spec-046 reserved-empty rule applied). |
| [`IDockAdapter`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/IDockAdapter) | App-supplied adapter for two paths the wrapper can't infer from the declarative `DockManager.Layout` alone: content rehydration after layout-JSON restore, and custom floating-window title bar chrome. |
| [`IDockBehavior`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/IDockBehavior) | App-supplied observation hook for dock and float lifecycle events. |
| [`IDockLayoutMigration`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/IDockLayoutMigration) | Layout-JSON schema migration step. |
| [`IDockLayoutStrategy`](/microsoft-ui-reactor/main/reference/docking/IDockLayoutStrategy) | Insertion-policy hook applied when a pane is added to the layout (programmatic insert, drag-drop landing, JSON restore). |
